name: code-review
description: Stack-agnostic code review: correctness bugs, code smells, convention drift on any diff or PR — severity-sorted one-line findings — plus comment discipline (default: no comment; write-time hooks warn, and deny the strictest patterns and any file over a 0.4:1 comment ceiling, at most twice per file per session; /code-review:comment-review). Defers structure/YAGNI to code-architecture, security depth to security, stack idioms to the per-framework review plugins. Includes /code-review:review, a code-reviewer agent, the code-smells, reuse-hygiene and comment-discipline skills; the fan-in loads every installed matching stack skill in one pass.

cc_comment_guard.title: Comment guard deny lane (CC_COMMENT_GUARD)
cc_comment_guard.description: Refuse a write whose comments restate the code or pass the density ceiling: on or off. The environment variable CC_COMMENT_GUARD overrides this.

cc_conventions.title: Conventions pointer (CC_CONVENTIONS)
cc_conventions.description: Name the convention configs and the CI command enforcing them at the first code write: on or off. The environment variable CC_CONVENTIONS overrides this.

cc_remind.title: Reminder hooks (CC_REMIND)
cc_remind.description: Reminder hooks that add guidance to the session: on or off. The environment variable CC_REMIND overrides this. Set in the shell, the variable mutes every plugin at once, while this option mutes only this plugin.

cc_review_nudge.title: Review-debt nudge (CC_REVIEW_NUDGE)
cc_review_nudge.description: Suggest an independent review once enough unreviewed or sensitive code has changed: on or off. The environment variable CC_REVIEW_NUDGE overrides this.
